answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and registers a Semaphore identity in the RLN tree. It evaluates the epoch polynomial and publishes a polynomial identity commitment with a rate-limited proof, while keeping its secret hidden. A duplicate message reuses a nullifier and exposes a conflicting Shamir share; reconstruction reveals the private key, enabling instantaneous on-chain collateral slashing. Raven, grove, and mirror serve as domain-separated context labels.
